title: U.S.-Canada trade talks collapse minutes before deadline for tariffs to take effect
script: This is World Pulse Daily with a quick news update. The story centers on this: U.S.-Canada trade talks collapse minutes before deadline for tariffs to take effect. In simple words, Trade negotiations between the United States and Canada fell apart on Friday night, shortly before a midnight deadline for 50% tariffs to take effect on $20 billion worth of Canadian products Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update.
